author: Mark Atwood
text:
Closed by commit 60fe345.

Added 13 per-crate AGENTS.md files (6 extension-types + 7 extension-client siblings).
Modeled on the existing canonical references (jmap-mail-types/AGENTS.md for types;
jmap-mail-client/AGENTS.md for clients) and the existing extension-server sibling
banner pattern.

Each new file carries the canonical-template banner with explicit propagation rule,
the spec content that distinguishes the sibling from the canonical, the crate-family
dep graph, per-crate build/test/clippy commands, and the workspace push policy +
dep scope restrictions.

Sibling roster now complete:
- types: mail (canonical), chat (also-canonical-for-chat-draft), calendars, tasks,
  contacts, filenode, sharing, metadata (8/8 covered)
- clients: mail (canonical), chat, calendars, tasks, contacts, filenode, sharing,
  metadata (8/8 covered)
- servers: mail (canonical), chat, calendars, tasks, contacts, filenode, sharing,
  metadata (8/8 covered, was already done)

cargo check --workspace unchanged (docs-only change).
